notes:
Cliopatria row: 1395-1481. The page has the sultanate established in 1394 (new 1394 keyframe) and annexed by Bahlul Lodi in 1479 (Bahlul Lodi page); end = 1479, so the 1475 shape is cut to 1475-1479 and Cliopatria's 1480-1481 years are dropped. Cliopatria's Lodi row takes Jaunpur's land only from 1482, three years after the page. The Jaunpur page's infobox gives 'disestablished 1494' (Hussain Shah beaten at Benares, exile at Kahalgaon 1494-1505, Sharqi inscriptions in Bihar to 1505); the rump has no extent on any page and is not drawn.
Not on the pages opened: Timur's 1398 invasion and the founding in 1398 (the page has 1394); Tirhut; any Gwalior campaign; the Sayyid-Jaunpur wars of the 1400s-1440s (no event for the 1407 Kanauj attempt, no counterpart named); a Bengal war (the Bengal dossier's overlap with Jaunpur's Bihar frontier is unrecorded). The page gives no area. Page budget (2) used: Jaunpur Sultanate and Bahlul Lodi.
Gazetteer: Jaunpur is not in the gazetteer (lon/lat used); Shamsabad, Kampil, Patiali, Suket, Marhara and Jalesar are not (nearby cities used).

Repair 2026-10-20 (reviewer sa-04-c): the end moves from 1479 to 1494 (Jaunpur page infobox 'Disestablished: 1494'; Hussain Shah beaten at Benares in 1494 and exiled to Kahalgaon; 'Sharqi inscriptions in Bihar continued until 1505'). Bahlul Lodi's 1479 annexation (Bahlul Lodi page) is the loss of the core, mirrored in lodi-dynasty; the east (Benares, Gorakhpur) is a rump to 1494, which Cliopatria gives to Lodi in 1497, and the Bihar block goes to Bengal in 1420 (Tirhut) and 1482 (south bank). This settles the conflict with sultanate-of-bengal /ledger (1482 gain) and lodi-dynasty /ledger (1494/1497 gain 'from the Sharqis'). The Bihar block is the loser's in 1395 (Bengal) and the rest of the 1395 gain is from tughlaq-dynasty. Added the 1415-1420 contest and the 1420 loss (confidence 1, no place on the Bengal page; the Ibrahim Shah Sharqi page has Ibrahim beating Raja Ganesha and not annexing). Shamsabad (1457) is mirrored in lodi-dynasty. Disagreement kept: the Bahlul Lodi page says 'annexed' in 1479 and the Jaunpur page says disestablished 1494; the infobox gives Hussain Shah's reign as 1458-1493, the ruler table 1458-1479. Rump extent 1479-1494 is a reading from Cliopatria's shapes (no page).
